name: transcribe-studio
description: Project-based meeting assistant with streaming ASR and agent revisions
author: Transcribe Studio

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.cjs tests/harness/*.test.cjs tests/audio/*.test.cjs tests/agents/*.test.cjs tests/context/*.test.cjs tests/workspace/*.test.cjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && node scripts/checks/structure.cjs
scripts.test:ui: npm run build && node scripts/ui/smoke.cjs && node scripts/ui/responsive.cjs && node scripts/ui/project-editor.cjs && node scripts/ui/search/palette.cjs && node scripts/ui/projects/overview.cjs && node scripts/ui/projects/workspace.cjs && node scripts/ui/meetings/lifecycle.cjs && node scripts/ui/meetings/annotations.cjs && node scripts/ui/setup/guidance.cjs && node scripts/ui/setup/connections.cjs && node scripts/ui/setup/devices.cjs && node scripts/ui/asr/services.cjs && node scripts/ui/asr/processing.cjs && node scripts/ui/setup/queue.cjs && node scripts/ui/design/primitives.cjs && node scripts/ui/design/react.cjs && node scripts/ui/design/typography.cjs && node scripts/ui/design/settings.cjs && node scripts/ui/motion/interactions.cjs && node scripts/ui/agents/cli.cjs && node scripts/ui/agents/activity.cjs && node scripts/ui/agents/context.cjs && node scripts/ui/projects/files.cjs && node scripts/ui/agents/session.cjs
scripts.package:portable: npm run build && node scripts/build/package.cjs portable
scripts.format: node scripts/checks/style.cjs --write && biome check --write --config-path=config/biome.json . && node scripts/checks/style.cjs
